environment.description: Container deployed on GKE Autopilot with the following pod security context: the container rootfs is mounted read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in securityContext), no tmpfs or emptyDir volumes are attached, and ephemeral storage is not provisioned. The pod runs with a distroless base image. An Istio sidecar (envoy proxy) is injected with protocol detection set to STRICT for HTTP, and the EnvoyFilter resource applies http_inspector listener filter with max_request_headers_kb: 60 and normalize_path: true. The Istio mesh policy enforces STRICT mTLS between all services. The envoy sidecar's HTTP connection manager has the following settings: allow_chunked_length: false, reject_unsupported_transfer_encodings: true, and merge_slashes: true in the route configuration.

config.volumes: none (no emptyDir, no tmpfs, no PVC)
